stewardship.source_contract: combat-phase-events Character skill exact-build reader ABI

identity.requirement: every occupied incumbent and candidate pointer roundtrips through its full-generation CharacterID

transaction.before: capture the private steward frame and require exact snapshot/public revision/native revision/date/owner/position equality
transaction.reads: resolve incumbent and every private candidate, then read stewardship using the frozen Character layout
transaction.after: capture the complete steward frame again and require byte-semantic equality with the before frame
transaction.caller_rule: invoke immediately after the private reader inside the same application-main query execution
transaction.failure_policy: any invalid identity, unreadable or negative skill, thread loss, frame mismatch or drift returns no enrichment rows

output.incumbent_main_skill: non-negative stewardship when occupied; -1 sentinel when vacant
output.candidate_rows: exact private row order and ordinals, final_eligible=true from GUI-mode native provider, non-negative stewardship

binding_glue.source: the attached exact-build steward binding used by the private R693 reader
binding_glue.fixture_chain: private steward read -> release -> enrichment access bind -> incumbent/candidate stewardship read -> public v1 projection

unique_next_blocker: register one public bridge query whose application-main executor runs the existing private read, enrichment binding/read, and public projection consecutively; then capture a paused public artifact
